subject: Vendor activation: PO number & spend-cap mapping for DataStream Analytics
messages:

Cc: accounts@datastream.ai
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Onboarding info + PO request (DataStream Analytics)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for moving DataStream through vendor activation. To finish our side we need the formal PO number and the spend cap mapping so we can bill correctly against the account. Attached are our W-9 and the invoice template we normally use.

Quick questions:
- Can you confirm the PO number (or provisional PO) that will be assigned to DataStream?
- Is there a hard spend cap we should enforce on invoices or should we break invoices by cost center/route?
- Our initial invoice uses a single SKU (CORE-ANALYTICS). Finance asked whether Redwood needs this split across two SKUs (CORE-S1, CORE-S2) for reconciliation.

If you can send the PO and any required invoice formatting guidelines, we’ll push an updated invoice today.

Attachments: Datastream_W9.pdf (application/pdf), initial_invoice_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Partnerships
DataStream Analytics

Hi Sanjay — looping in Procurement (Laura) and Finance (Vivek) to get the official PO and invoicing guidance.

Laura/Vivek: DataStream attached W-9 and says they bill with a single SKU. Can we:
1) Issue a provisional PO or confirm final PO number?
2) Confirm whether we require line-item SKU splits for accounting (CORE-S1 / CORE-S2) or whether a single merged SKU is acceptable; if acceptable, we need to map that SKU to our internal cost centers.
3) If there are any spend cap constraints for new vendors, please note them so the vendor can enforce on their invoicing.

Sanjay — expect a follow up from Laura with PO and invoice template comments.

Thanks,
Hannah
Sr. Manager, Vendor Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@datastream.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2026 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding info + PO request (DataStream Analytics)

Hi Hannah / Sanjay — thanks for the docs. I’m provisioning a PO but there are two items we need clarified before we finalize:

1) Provisional PO and spend cap
- PO number (provisional): PO-DSA-67903
- Spend cap for initial quarter: $120,000 (this is a hard cap in the billing system until we confirm monthly cadence)

2) Line-item mapping
- Our GL requires separate line-items for: CORE-S1 (platform ingestion) and CORE-S2 (model inference). The vendor file has CORE-ANALYTICS as one combined line. When invoices arrive as a single SKU our automated matching fails and routing to cost centers gets delayed.
- Can DataStream send a revised invoice that splits the existing combined row into two rows and includes unit quantities and per-unit rates? Example: CORE-S1: 3000 units @ $2.50; CORE-S2: 1500 units @ $5.00.

3) Invoice header & PO placement
- Please put the PO number on the invoice top line and in the invoice metadata (invoice_number field). We prefer the attached Redwood_PO_template.xlsx to avoid rework.

Attached: Redwood_PO_template.xlsx (spreadsheet) — Sanjay, if you can return a draft invoice using that template I’ll sign and convert the provisional PO to final.

Let me know if the spend cap needs to be increased (we can do an expedited review if they need >$120k).

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@datastream.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@datastream.ai
Date: Sat, 29 May 2026 11:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding info + PO request (DataStream Analytics)

Hi Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. I’ve attached a corrected invoice that splits CORE-ANALYTICS into CORE-S1 and CORE-S2 with unit counts per your example.

A few notes:
- We included PO-DSA-67903 in the invoice header and metadata.
- We left unit rates identical to the estimate you shared; if you need changes to pricing we can issue a revised quote but prefer to keep the invoice consistent with onboarding pricing.
- Attached also is a signed W-9 on company letterhead.

Attachments: DSA_invoice_breakdown_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Datastream_W9_signed.pdf (pdf)

Please confirm once the PO is final and the spend cap is accepted. If you need an increased cap for the first two months let me know and I can send support for the request.

Appreciate it,
Sanjay
